risks: Live host/core wave0 bytes can change before integration; source hashes are inspection evidence, not committed implementation receipts.
Naive reuse of JsonCanvas duplicates content authority, loses unknown fields and can overwrite malformed data with seeded/empty geometry.
Workspace/note-only Outline folds storage does not establish per-user isolation; independent in-component state also loses cross-view preferences.
Read-only/unanchored/ambiguous identities must not be silently converted or persisted as transient projection keys.

Renderer/core-only allowed files cannot establish server ACL, independent durable layout revision, authenticated actor, event privacy or crash recovery. Missing native ownership is fail closed, not adapter simulation.
Published RS-DOC-01 Drive/message and collaborative-document foundations are hidden gates beyond the sole explicit predecessor; a plan or publication does not close them.
Actual NoteViewKind/core export/caller/localization seams exceed the currently named allocation and require reviewed scope updates, not a broad shared-file rewrite.
Large trees need bounded layout/focus/export work and readable-fit policies; pointer/mobile gestures must coexist with IME and editing caret.
Structural and geometry undo differ: stale layout must never overwrite concurrent text, and semantic local undo must preserve remote edits.
No builds, tests, UI or network lanes were run; report validation establishes preflight integrity only, never feature completeness.
